title: Read a provisioned device identity
purpose: Check the selected Workshop record against the permanent identity on one USB-connected board and its visible label.
prerequisites: Use an enabled Workshop operator account with a provisioned device record, its article revision and recorded USB hardware ID. Either ownership state is eligible.
Use a labelled board already running one of the listed images, a USB data cable, the reviewed P1 runner and a writable private local evidence folder.

steps.action: Sign in, select the provisioned device record and its matching role and build, then choose Run.
steps.expected: The selection shows the intended UUID, serial, role and ownership context.
evidence: Role, source and expected image hash

steps.action: Save the started attempt locally before prompting for the cable or discovering USB devices.
steps.expected: The attempt has an ID, start time, operator, participant, Workshop build and exact definition snapshot and digest. A local save error stops discovery.
evidence: Local start record or visible save error

steps.action: Connect the selected board by USB in normal application mode and acknowledge the connection prompt.
steps.expected: The operator identifies the board and records the cable connection.

steps.action: Check the selected registry hardware ID, application-mode target, role, image binding, runner and contracts. Issue the shared read-only P1 identity action.
steps.expected: One target returns a valid ready, idle identity matching the expected hardware, full source, role, registry UUID, serial, article and revision.
evidence: Runner provenance, bounded response or error, step outcome

steps.action: Read the serial on the physical label and enter what you see. Record an unreadable or missing label explicitly.
steps.expected: The observed serial matches the displayed readback. An absent observation leaves this check incomplete.
evidence: Operator, observed label or reason unavailable, comparison and time

steps.action: Save and reopen the private report for this attempt.
steps.expected: The reopened report preserves the definition and build bindings, ordered results, observations, outcome and artifact checksums.
evidence: Local report ID and reopen result
Artifact manifest with lengths and hashes

steps.action: Export the reopened report and record whether the export completed.
steps.expected: The operator can identify the exported report. On export failure the local report remains available for retry.
evidence: Export result and exported report digest or error

rules.pass: All required checks and observations succeed with matching bindings, a reopened report and export evidence.
rules.fail: A malformed, oversized, timed-out or disconnected read, mismatched permanent identity or observed label fails its step. Retain the diagnostic and leave dependent steps unrun.
rules.blocked: Stop on an unsupported or ambiguous target, role, pinned build, runner or contract. Preserve the attempt and reason.
rules.incomplete: Keep cancelled or interrupted attempts, missing observations, local save failures and export errors explicit. Leave unexecuted steps unrun. Link each retry to its prior attempt.
